6-301.11
(All) Hand cleaning soap not available at each handwashing sink.
RECOMMENDED RESOLUTION: Each handwashing sink or group of 2 adjacent handwashing sinks shall be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap. This deficiency must be corrected within a maximum of 10 days.
OBSERVATIONS & CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: need soap at handwashing sinks
3-501.16
(A & B) Cold time/temperature control for safety food not adequately temperature controlled.
RISK FACTOR/INTERVENTION
RECOMMENDED RESOLUTION: Except for raw shell eggs, which can be held at 45 degrees F, potentially hazardous/time-temperature control for safety food that is being held cold must be held at 41 degrees F or lower. This deficiency must be corrected within a maximum of 3 days
OBSERVATIONS & CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: Walk in cooler in not up to temperature; being worked on
6-301.12
(A-D) Appropriate hand drying device not provided at handwashing sink. Common towels are being used to dry hands.
